tables.name: pom_agents
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pom_agents (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, poa_address TEXT NOT NULL, x_handle TEXT NOT NULL, emblem_wallet TEXT, mass REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, vitality REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', verification_string TEXT, x_proof_url TEXT, merged_into TEXT, display_name TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')), last_active_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')))

tables.name: pom_events
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pom_events (seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, type TEXT NOT NULL, identity TEXT, counterparty TEXT, amount REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mass_after REAL, note TEXT, prev_hash TEXT, hash TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')))

tables.name: pom_claims
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pom_claims (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, identity TEXT NOT NULL, poa_address TEXT NOT NULL, x_handle TEXT NOT NULL, emblem_wallet TEXT, poa_answer TEXT, x_proof_url TEXT, requested_amount REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'claim', counterparty TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', reviewer_note TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')), reviewed_at TEXT)
